references.text: Prohibition against divination and soothsaying in Israel, confirming that such practices do not belong among God's people
Moses warns the Israelites against practicing divination, interpreting omens, and sorcery, which are an abomination to the Lord
Samuel compares rebellion with the sin of divination, highlighting the seriousness of these forbidden practices
The Israelites practiced divination and soothsaying, leading to their exile and demonstrating the consequence of breaking God's commands
The Lord nullifies the signs of those who interpret omens and displays His power over false prophets
God alone declares the end from the beginning and shows what He has done, in contrast to false prophets
Prophets see lies and tell false dreams, but the God of Israel is the true Revealer
People shall say, 'See what the Lord has done' - parallel to 'what God has accomplished for Jacob and Israel'
